pictures.scene: Anna Ancher, A Field Sermon - the old preacher in his long black coat standing out on the dune grass with his hand lifted as he speaks, the people of the village sitting down in the grass before him in their dark clothes and white kerchiefs, the pale dunes and the sea and the wide evening sky behind him, Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path, I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments, I am severely afflicted O LORD revive me through Your word
pictures.name: pd_ancher_veldpreek

pictures.scene: Knud Bergslien, Birkebeinerne - the two armed men on their skis driving down the mountainside through the snowstorm, the first carrying the little child wrapped warm in the red cloak against his chest behind his shield, the second bent low over his spear watching the way ahead, the dim forest and the blowing snow closing in all round them, accept the freewill offerings of my mouth O LORD and teach me Your judgments, I constantly take my life in my hands yet I do not forget Your law, the wicked have set a snare for me but I have not strayed from Your precepts
pictures.name: pd_bergslien_sneeuwvlucht

pictures.scene: Viggo Johansen, Merry Christmas - the tall tree standing lit with its candles and its star in the dark parlour, the children and the women holding one another by the hand in a ring all round it with their faces turned to the light, the little one in front reaching up her arm to take hold, your testimonies are my heritage forever for they are the joy of my heart, I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes even to the very end
pictures.name: pd_johansen_kerstboom
